shapePolicies: Trace cabin/trunk/stone/fence Walls from ground footprint only.
Trees at perimeter remain scenery where off-path; overhead crowns separate Tiles only if tokens can move beneath.
Road and lane regions use narrow threshold rectangles in actual walkable dirt, not giant proximity Regions.
Gate traverses the cleared NW trail between pillars; initially blocks entry from Yard, opens on SG-03 inner unlatch.
Shack and privy exteriors are visible roof structures on Yard but interiors belong to separate scenes.
Bathhouse enters via SG-06 shrine-trail fork so no new unseen side exit is invented on the already-approved Yard art.
Locked carriage visible but inner contents and Ladder Hook are explicit post-unlock interaction states.
releaseGate: This establishes image scale and candidate point anchors only. Placement of Wall segments, Region polygons, Tile footprints, lights and door links must use verified semantic geometry + source dimensions in installed Scene; no runtime success implied.
